info.name: ETP - Cognito & Auth (platform testing)
info.description:
Cognito and JWT/role authorization checks for the ETP backend, runnable against local Floci (scripts/Seed-EtpCognitoUsers.ps1) or a real pool.

Run folders in order (Collection Runner, environment 'ETP Local - Floci'). 00 resolves pool/client ids; 01 stores per-role tokens used by 03-08.

Prereqs: docker compose up -d in floci/, ./seed-users.ps1, Admin service on :5101 configured with the printed Authority/Metadata/ClientId/PoolId.

request.description: Resolves the pool id and Authority so you don't have to copy them from the seed output. Authority format matches scripts/Seed-EtpCognitoUsers.ps1 (http://localhost:4566/<poolId>).

exec: pm.test('Admin pool exists (run scripts/Seed-EtpCognitoUsers.ps1 if not)', () => pm.expect(pool, 'pool '+pm.environment.get('admin_pool_name')).to.exist);
if (pool) { pm.environment.set('admin_pool_id', pool.Id); pm.environment.set('admin_authority', pm.environment.get('floci_oidc_url') + '/' + pool.Id); }

item.name: List users in pool (ListUsers, signed - pick pool via {{admin_pool_id}}/{{user_pool_id}}/{{ticketchecker_pool_id}}/{{agent_pool_id}})

request.description: All users of a pool with their custom:role / custom:program_ids (the same call the backend AdminUserProvider uses via ListUsersAsync). Swap the UserPoolId body variable to inspect user/ticket-checker/agent pools. IMPORTANT: signed request - unsigned calls return 'pool does not exist' in Floci (and fail on real AWS too)].

exec: pm.test('Pool has users (run scripts/Seed-EtpCognitoUsers.ps1 if not)', () => pm.expect((res.Users||[]).length).to.be.above(0));

request.description: The backend loads this at AWS:CognitoPool:Admin:Metadata. A mismatched issuer is the usual cause of blanket 401s.

exec: pm.test('at least one signing key', () => pm.expect(keys.length).to.be.above(0));
pm.test('keys are RSA with kid', () => keys.forEach(k => { pm.expect(k.kty).to.eql('RSA'); pm.expect(k.kid).to.be.a('string'); }));

item.description: A 403 means the token validated but the role claim (added by CognitoUserAttributesMiddleware from custom:role) was missing or wrong. A 401 means JWT validation failed. 'Allowed' rows other than admin-users only assert not 401/403 because those endpoints may need query params.
